Evidence and decisions

Quick readMore contextTechnical detailSpeaker notes

When AI helps with research, someone later has to ask what evidence supports this, what is uncertain, and what the action was allowed to do. GKOS is my developing approach to keeping those links. Provenance lets you inspect a claim. It does not make the claim true.
